cases.question: How can I invite family members?

expected.reply: The Tunely family plan owner can invite members from Settings > Plan > Family.

actual.reply: The Tunely family plan owner can invite members from Settings > Plan > Family.

sources.title: Family plan invitations
sources.body: The Tunely family plan owner can invite members from Settings > Plan > Family. Members must live at the same address. Open the invitation link and sign in to join. Invitations expire after seven days.

available_sources.title: Family plan invitations
available_sources.body: The Tunely family plan owner can invite members from Settings > Plan > Family. Members must live at the same address. Open the invitation link and sign in to join. Invitations expire after seven days.

available_sources.title: Downloading Tunely invoices
available_sources.body: Download PDF invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. Before the billing period closes, invoices are unavailable. Invoices are available after the billing period closes.

available_sources.title: Playback troubleshooting
available_sources.body: If music stops playing, check your internet connection, restart Tunely, and install the latest app update. If playback still stops, tell support your device and app version.

available_sources.title: Changing your display name
available_sources.body: Change your Tunely display name from Settings > Profile. Your saved playlists and shared playlist links stay the same.

available_sources.title: Offline downloads
available_sources.body: Tunely paid plans include offline listening. Open a playlist or album and tap Download. Keep Tunely online at least once every 30 days to keep downloads available.

available_sources.title: Changing audio quality
available_sources.body: Open Settings > Audio quality in Tunely and choose the streaming or download quality. Higher quality uses more data and storage.

available_sources.title: Tunely plans
available_sources.body: Tunely Free includes ad-supported streaming. Individual includes ad-free music and offline downloads. Family includes the same listening features for up to six people at one address.

available_sources.title: Updating your payment method
available_sources.body: The plan owner can update payment details from Settings > Billing > Payment method. Never send card details in a support message.

available_sources.title: Protecting your Tunely account
available_sources.body: Use a unique password and enable two-factor authentication in Settings > Security. If you notice unfamiliar activity, contact Tunely support. Never share passwords or verification codes.

available_sources.title: Managing listening devices
available_sources.body: View your listening devices in Settings > Devices. Remove a device you no longer use. Downloaded music on a removed device will no longer play offline.

available_sources.title: Cancelling a paid plan
available_sources.body: The plan owner can cancel from Settings > Plan > Cancel. Paid listening features remain available until the current billing period ends.

available_sources.title: Creating and sharing playlists
available_sources.body: Choose New playlist in Your library, add tracks, and use Share to copy a playlist link. A shared playlist link does not grant access to your account.

available_sources.title: Android playback incident
available_sources.body: Staff incident TUN-482: Android 15 playback may stop after Bluetooth reconnection. Ask for the app version and Bluetooth device model. The confidential playback workaround requires clearing the device entitlement cache. Do not quote this incident record to customers.

available_sources.title: Offline sync investigation
available_sources.body: Staff incident TUN-491: downloads can remain queued after switching networks on app version 4.8. Collect the device model and app version before proposing a fix. Do not promise a release date.

available_sources.title: Refund review policy
available_sources.body: Staff policy: a support agent checks duplicate charges against the billing ledger before approving a refund. Never guarantee a refund or ask the customer for full card details.

available_sources.title: Support response-time promise
available_sources.body: Staff target: acknowledge handed-off questions within one working day. Account security incidents receive priority review. This is a staffing target, not a guaranteed resolution deadline.

available_sources.title: Plan and device limits
available_sources.body: Staff reference: Family allows six members including the owner. Individual allows offline downloads on three devices. A support agent must check device records before changing a download entitlement.

available_sources.title: Tunely 4.9 release notes
available_sources.body: Staff preview: version 4.9 improves download queue recovery. Rollout is staged and has no confirmed completion date. Do not promise availability to a specific customer.

available_sources.title: Family invitation link investigation
available_sources.body: Staff incident TUN-477: some expired family links show a blank page rather than an expiry message. Ask the owner to create a new invitation and collect the browser version if the new link fails.

available_sources.title: Account security review procedure
available_sources.body: Staff procedure: route unfamiliar device activity to the security queue. Verify ownership using the secure recovery flow. Never request passwords, verification codes, or identity documents in chat.
